paragraphs.tag: MAP: intro-1 | wide view of the region, title card
paragraphs.text: In the spring, the caravan left the old city of Orel. Ahead lay two hundred kilometres of open steppe.

paragraphs.tag: MAP: intro-2 | route draws on to Kursk, markers pulse
paragraphs.text: Day after day they followed the river south. Twelve days later, they reached Kursk.
